newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - 99 Cents Only estimates up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - 99 Cents Only estimates up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it raised its earnings estimate for 99 Cents Only Stores for fiscal 1997 to $1.19 from $1.15 a share and its estimate for fiscal 1998 earnings to $1.45 from $1.42.
-- The company reported earnings of $0.97 a share for fiscal 1996, outpacing EVEREN's estimate of $0.94, EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN said the increase reflects adjustments made to its expense ratio and gross margin assumptions.
-- 99 Cents Only operates a retail concept chain.
-- Its shares were up 1/2 Wednesday at 18-1/4.
